title: Healing Ethiopian Oxtail Flatbread
description: A winey, crumbly low‑carb injera‑style flatbread filled with slow‑cooked oxtail, perfect for a sick day comfort meal.
instructions: Sear oxtail pieces in olive oil until browned on all sides.
Transfer oxtail to a clay pot and add diced onion, minced garlic, and ginger.
Pour in red wine, tomato paste, berbere, beef broth, and honey; stir to combine.
Cover pot and simmer on low heat for 90 minutes until oxtail is tender and sauce has thickened.
Whisk almond flour, egg, and a pinch of salt together to form a crumbly batter.
Ladle the batter into the clay pot over the oxtail stew, spreading it evenly to cover the surface.
Place the pot in a preheated oven at 200°C and bake for 20 minutes until the batter forms a golden crust.
Remove from oven, let sit 5 minutes, then slice into wedges to serve.
Garnish with fresh lemon juice and chopped cilantro before serving.
